shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -50 && git ls-files | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "markdown\|editor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120

npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components katex lowlight markdown-it highlight.js @diplodoc/transform @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/html-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension @diplodoc/latex-extension @diplodoc/mermaid-extension @diplodoc/quote-link-extension @diplodoc/folding-headings-extension 2>&1 | tail -15; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/dist/docs 2>&1 | head

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json | tr -d '[]," ' | grep '^4\.' | tail -25); do echo "$v $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null)"; done

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 katex lowlight markdown-it highlight.js @diplodoc/transform @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/html-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension @diplodoc/latex-extension @diplodoc/mermaid-extension @diplodoc/quote-link-extension @diplodoc/folding-headings-extension 2>&1 | tail -15; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/dist/docs 2>&1 | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -150; ls -R guides | head -40; grep '"version"' ../../package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides && cat how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md | head -120; echo ------; cat how-to-add-preview.md | head -80; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 120,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md; grep -rn "styles" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | head; grep -n "initialEditorMode\|initialSplitModeEnabled\|initialToolbarVisible\|splitMode\|markupConfig\|wysiwygConfig" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts | head -20; cat vite.config.ts tsconfig.json

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles | head; grep -rn "styles.css\|import '@gravity-ui/markdown-editor" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs -r | head; grep -n "initialEditorMode\|initialToolbarVisible\|initialSplitModeEnabled\|splitMode" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts | head; grep -n "Form\|TextArea" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -5

sed -n 1,140p node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts; sed -n 165,190p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n "styles" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "\"\\./\\*\\|\"\\.\"" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | head

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh components FormRow 2>&1 | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/FormRow/FormRow.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; grep -n "TextInput\|Button" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -2

sed -i 's|<MarkdownEditorView editor={editor} />|<MarkdownEditorView editor={editor} stickyToolbar={false} />|' src/MarkdownField.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && echo TSC_DONE && rm -rf dist && git status --short
